query.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000)
select id_dh, SUM(ISNULL(t_ttx, 0)) t_ttx_m72 into #m72 from m72 a where EXISTS (select 1 from s61 b where a.id_dh = b.id) group by id_dh select id_dh, SUM(ISNULL(t_ttx, 0)) t_ttx_m54 into #m54 from m54 a where EXISTS (select 1 from s61 b where a.id_dh = b.id) group by id_dh
SELECT a.id_dh, b.t_ttx_m72, a.t_ttx_m54 into #m54_1 FROM #m54 a JOIN #m72 b ON b.id_dh = a.id_dh WHERE b.t_ttx_m72 <> a.t_ttx_m54
set @strKey = ' id_dh in (select id_dh from #m54_1) '
exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join s61 d on a.id_dh = d.id', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh,c.dien_thoai, d.ma_job ma_dh, d.so_job so_dh', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId
drop table #unitright drop table #m72 drop table #m54

finding.text:
declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = ''
select id_dh, SUM(t_ttx) t_ttx_m72 into #m72 from m72 a where EXISTS (select 1 from s61 b where a.id_dh = b.id) group by id_dh select id_dh, SUM(t_ttx) t_ttx_m54 into #m54 from m54 a where EXISTS (select 1 from s61 b where a.id_dh = b.id) group by id_dh
SELECT a.id_dh, ISNULL(b.t_ttx_m72,0) t_ttx_m72, ISNULL(a.t_ttx_m54,0) t_ttx_m54 into #m54_1 FROM #m54 a JOIN #m72 b ON b.id_dh = a.id_dh WHERE ISNULL(b.t_ttx_m72,0) > ISNULL(a.t_ttx_m54,0)
if @ma_vt <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.ma_vt like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@ma_vt) + '%'''
if @so_hd <> '' set @strDetailKey = @strDetailKey + ' and x.so_hd like N''' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLValue(@so_hd) + '%'''
if @strDetailKey <> '' set @strDetailKey = ' and exists(select 1 from d54 x where a.id = x.id ' + @strDetailKey + ')'
set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + ' and ' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionGetUnitIDRightKeys(@@admin, @@userId, @ma_unit, 'a.unit_id') + @strDetailKey
if @ma_job1 <> N'' set @strKey = @strKey+' and id_dh in (select id from s61 where ma_job like N''%' + @ma_job1 + '%'')' if @so_ct2 <> N'' set @strKey = @strKey+' and id_dh in (select id from s61 where so_job like N''%' + @so_ct2 + '%'')'
set @strKey = @strKey + ' and id_dh in (select id_dh from #m54_1) '
exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmkh c on a.ma_kh = c.ma_kh left join s61 d on a.id_dh = d.id', 'b.ma_unit, c.ten_kh,c.dien_thoai, d.ma_job ma_dh, d.so_job so_dh', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId drop table #unitright
